headline: Integrate: Vulkan bordered-cubemap mip copies use valid extents, replacing the parent VUID/device-loss path.
scope: The timing table measures exact PR #15 head cb89434e45a5191eda85abba25812192fe1c9b21 against exact PR #14 head eb338262714ef0b1e23fd60a2c168300443377ac. PGR2 uses two 60-second ABBA runs per build and renderer; Morrowind uses one 10-second snapshot per build and renderer. All cadence values are NV2A display-write rates, not rendered FPS.
